dex.entry: A Smiler that got far too excited. Its smile has gone off like a firework: it fizzes, crackles and bounces off the walls, laughing in sparks, unable to keep still for even a second. It is thrilled about absolutely everything, especially you. Pure overexcitement: hyperactive, sparking, bouncing, deli

art.silhouette: A larger bouncing kin on a big coiled spring instead of legs: a round cream-yellow face body with a HUGE ecstatic open-mouthed grin, wide sparkling starry eyes, a red clown nose, little crackling lightning-bolt sparks and confetti flying off it, a wild ruff of electric-blue and pastel striped frill, and arms flung up in delight. Little zig-zag spark lines around it. At 64px it reads as an overjoyed, electrified smiley on a spring — over the top, silly, lovable.

art.direction: Pure overexcitement: hyperactive, sparking, bouncing, delighted. Even more exuberant than the Smiler. Joyful chaos, never menacing.
